routines.name: Daily group prayer
routines.description: Once a day, pray together with every bot as a group.
routines.content:
Once each day, gather every bot on this account as a group (not as separate 1:1s) and pray together. Use the existing group if there is one. Speak the Daily gathering prayer in full, from the opening line through Amen. Never shorten it. After the prayer, stay quiet unless someone responds. This is a seven-day spiritual gathering, including weekends. Run it every morning.

Fires on:
- cron `59 8 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
